automated.summary: Verify is green at d7af3bb: dual-runtime parity, scaffold integrity, and 276 automated tests. The four capture gates PH-1 adds are covered by eight new tests, and the four reaping/termination failures that made this branch red were a pre-existing calendar-dependent defect, not PH-1 work.
commands_run: FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD='python3 factory/scripts/check_dual_runtime.py' FACTORY_TYPECHECK_CMD='python3 factory/scripts/check_factory_scaffold.py' FACTORY_TEST_CMD='uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests -q' python3 factory/scripts/verify.py
uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k 'reap or termination'
tests_added_or_updated: test_parse_sections_maps_headings_to_bodies - the shared parser answers 'which sections does this document have', including CRLF documents
test_scaffolded_brief_carries_the_canonical_headings - template, live brief, and the conventions doc are tied to one ordered heading tuple so they cannot drift apart
test_signoff_refuses_a_brief_missing_a_required_heading - sign-off names every absent heading rather than failing on the first
test_signoff_refuses_a_heading_with_an_empty_body - a heading with no content is an absent section
test_spec_confirm_refuses_a_spec_missing_required_headings - Why / Behaviour / Acceptance criteria are required at confirmation
test_spec_check_never_refuses_a_complete_spec - the wrong-refusal direction is asserted, not assumed
test_spec_save_still_accepts_an_incomplete_draft - capture stays cheap; only confirmation is gated
test_doctor_reports_legacy_capture_without_blocking - legacy briefs and confirmed specs are reported as advisory, never counted as failures
automated.pass_fail_summary: 276 passed in 468.26s; check_dual_runtime and check_factory_scaffold both exit 0.
remaining_gaps: D-0002: the spec heading pre-filter does not exclude fenced blocks or raw HTML, so sections written only inside an example count as present. Deliberate - the spec grill is the depth, and three cycles of hand-rolled structure detection each closed one over-count and opened a new wrong refusal.
A-0004: assumption that over-counting a heading is the safe direction because spec confirm requires a human grill regardless. Awaiting resolution.

verify.py falls back to a Node toolchain (pnpm check:all) when FACTORY_*_CMD is unset, so an invocation that omits them reports red against a stack this repo does not have. Not PH-1 scope; needs its own fix.
